matrix_convention: Column vectors: coordinates_gps = rotation_camera_to_gps * coordinates_camera; matrix columns are camera axes expressed in the GPS module frame.
limitations: STEP component frame axes are not verified against the camera optical or sensor axes.
The GPS module frame is not an ENU, north, or heading reference.
The candidate camera-to-IMU mechanical estimate is in camera_imu_step_approx.json and is not applied.
This estimate is not applied in processing and must not be used for science.
